const compareCmd = `python3 -B - <<'PY'
import json, re, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path("tools").resolve()))
from i18nlib.config import load_manifest
from i18nlib.lint import AT_TOKEN_RE, MARKUP_RE
from i18nlib.locale_model import LocaleLoader
from i18nlib.runtime import LuaRuntime

root = Path.cwd()
task = root / ".ai/task/repair-w38-20260926"
items = json.loads((task / "WORKSET.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["items"]
expected = {
    (item["normalized_path"], item["section"], item["source"], item.get("source_tag")):
    item["entry_revision_identity"]
    for item in items
}
assert len(items) == len(expected) == 24
loader = LocaleLoader(LuaRuntime(load_manifest()))
changed = {}
non_target = []
records_compared = 0
line_ok = 0
format_ok = 0
placeholder = re.compile(r'%[-+ #0]*\\d*(?:\\.\\d+)?[cdeEfgGiouXxqs%]')
template = re.compile(r'<\\?=.*?\\?>', re.S)

def leading_tabs(s):
    return [len(line) - len(line.lstrip("\\t")) for line in s.split("\\n")]

def blank_indices(s):
    return [i for i, line in enumerate(s.split("\\n")) if line == ""]

for rel in ("tome-cults.lua", "tome-orcs.lua"):
    base = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "show", f"HEAD:{rel}"], cwd=root, check=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE
    ).stdout
    old = loader.load_bytes(base, logical_path=rel).translations
    new = loader.load_path(root / rel, logical_path=rel).translations
    assert len(old) == len(new), (rel, len(old), len(new))
    records_compared += len(old)
    for before, after in zip(old, new):
        stable = ("kind", "function_name", "section", "source", "source_tag", "args_order", "special")
        if any(before.get(k) != after.get(k) for k in stable):
            non_target.append((rel, before.get("line"), after.get("line"), "identity"))
            continue
        if before["target"] == after["target"]:
            continue
        key = (rel, after["section"], after["source"], after.get("source_tag"))
        revision = expected.get(key)
        if revision is None:
            non_target.append((rel, after.get("line"), None, "target-outside-workset"))
            continue
        assert revision not in changed, revision
        assert before["target"] == next(x["target_preimage"] for x in items if x["entry_revision_identity"] == revision)
        changed[revision] = key
        source, target = after["source"], after["target"]
        assert source.count("\\n") == target.count("\\n"), revision
        assert leading_tabs(source) == leading_tabs(target), revision
        assert blank_indices(source) == blank_indices(target), revision
        assert not target.endswith("\\t") and "\\r" not in target, revision
        line_ok += 1
        assert placeholder.findall(source) == placeholder.findall(target), revision
        assert MARKUP_RE.findall(source) == MARKUP_RE.findall(target), revision
        assert AT_TOKEN_RE.findall(source) == AT_TOKEN_RE.findall(target), revision
        assert template.findall(source) == template.findall(target), revision
        format_ok += 1

assert not non_target, non_target
assert len(changed) == 24, len(changed)
assert set(changed) == {x["entry_revision_identity"] for x in items}
needle = "科技的奇迹，如今为真正的屠戮效力！"
assert loader.load_path(root / "tome-orcs.lua", logical_path="tome-orcs.lua").translations
assert (root / "tome-orcs.lua").read_text(encoding="utf-8").count(needle) == 1
for rel in ("tome-cults.lua", "tome-orcs.lua"):
    data = (root / rel).read_bytes()
    assert b"\\r" not in data and data.endswith(b"\\n"), rel
print(json.dumps({
    "verified": True,
    "runtime": str(loader.runtime.luajit),
    "files_loaded": 2,
    "records_compared": records_compared,
    "changed_targets_relative_to_HEAD": len(changed),
    "workset_exact": True,
    "non_target_changes": 0,
    "line_tab_blank_invariants": f"{line_ok}/24",
    "placeholder_markup_template_invariants": f"{format_ok}/24",
    "confirmed_successor_occurrences": 1,
    "pure_lf_and_terminal_newline": True
}, ensure_ascii=False))
PY`;
const jobs = [
  ["LUAJIT_COMPARE", compareCmd, 8000],
  ["STRICT_LINT", "python3 -B tools/i18n lint --strict", 12000],
  ["DIFF_CHECK", "git diff --check", 4000]
];
const results = await Promise.all(jobs.map(async ([label, cmd, max]) => {
  const r = await tools.exec_command({
    cmd,
    workdir: "/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation",
    yield_time_ms: 30000,
    max_output_tokens: max,
    sandbox_permissions: "require_escalated",
    justification: "允许我运行用户要求的最终有界验证：LuaJIT 24-target 比较、strict lint 与 git diff --check 吗？"
  });
  return [label, r];
}));
for (const [label, r] of results) text(`${label} EXIT ${r.exit_code}\n${r.output}`);
